## Scope

Describe the focused change and its user/accounting effect.

## Verification

List focused tests, project gates, and any platform/runtime not verified locally.

## Document disposition

For each document: **updated** (what and why), **reviewed; no change needed**
(why), or **not applicable** (why). See CONTRIBUTING.md, Document review.

## Repository contract

- [ ] Every commit has the author's `Signed-off-by:` DCO trailer.
- [ ] A tool that wrote a material part of a commit is named in an `Assisted-by:` trailer.
- [ ] Financial fixtures are synthetic or deliberately sanitized.
- [ ] Every document above has a disposition, and each updated document is accurate
      for this change.
- [ ] A change a user would notice has a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `Unreleased`.
